ND-2025-SB2129.aiSummary: This law updates North Dakota rules for veterinary medicine, veterinary technology, and recognized animal services. It changes and repeals several parts of the state code tied to those jobs and adds a penalty for breaking the rules. The measure was signed by the governor and filed with the state.
